cards.card_text: Then comes Solomon's food for a single day: fine flour and meal by the cor, oxen, game and fattened poultry, with a hundred sheep on top.
cards.verse_text: Solomon’s provisions for a single day were thirty cors of fine flour, sixty cors of meal, ten fat oxen, twenty range oxen, and a hundred sheep, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened poultry.
cards.snippet: Solomon’s provisions for a single day were thirty cors of fine flour, sixty cors of meal, ten fat oxen, twenty range…

cards.card_text: So Hiram provides all the cedar and cypress Solomon wants, and Solomon sends Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, plus 20,000 baths of pure olive oil.
cards.verse_text: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar and cypress timber he wanted, and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, as well as 20,000 baths of pure olive oil.
cards.snippet: …he wanted, and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, as well as 20,000 baths…

cards.card_text: And that year the Ammonites give him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand cors of barley.
cards.verse_text: Jotham waged war against the king of the Ammonites and defeated them, and that year they gave him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley.
cards.snippet: …that year they gave him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley.

cards.card_text: The treasurers must give up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine and a hundred baths of olive oil.
cards.verse_text: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.
cards.snippet: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive…
